normal.name: Normal Vesicular Sounds
normal.description: Unremarkable breath sounds without adventitious acoustic signatures.

wheeze.name: Wheezes
wheeze.description: Continuous, high-pitched musical sounds produced by narrowed airways.

crackle.name: Crackles (Rales)
crackle.description: Discontinuous, explosive, brief clicking or rattling sounds.

wheeze_crackle.name: Wheeze + Crackle Co-occurrence
wheeze_crackle.description: Simultaneous adventitious presence of wheezing and crackling.

stridor.name: Stridor
stridor.description: Harsh, vibrating, high-pitched inspiratory sound indicating laryngeal obstruction.

recommended_split.methodology: Patient-Independent (Patient IDs 101-180 in train, 181-226 in test)
recommended_split.leakage_prevention: Strictly forbids recordings from the same patient across splits.
